acceptanceCriteria: A reopened ticket's no-progress streak counts only hand-offs after its last completion receipt, with a focused regression test.
The doctor spec failure mode is replaced by a numbered requirement.
body: Follow-up to V1-1176 (TQD-V0-013). The fix skips tickets whose current status is COMPLETED/ARCHIVED/HELD, but a ticket completed and then reopened still counts hand-offs from before its completion, because the scan does not read ticket record transitions. Recorded as a failure mode in docs/specs/corvint-tasks-doctor-v0.md.

completion.reason: Delivered on origin/main 2b0cfce94; every acceptance criterion re-verified read-only in the pre-1.0 sweep. Evidence: docs/build-log/2026-10-20-pre-1-0-sweep-delivered-closures.md (decision 0547).

title: tasks doctor: reset the NO_PROGRESS_HANDOFF streak at the completion receipt for reopened tickets (GH #791 follow-up)
